text: 国家质量强国建设协调推进领导小组办公室会同有关成员单位近日组成4个质量督察组，启动2026年第二批质量督察工作。11月5日起，4个督察组陆续进驻安徽、江西、河南、四川等省份，将持续聚焦贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于质量工作决策部署情况、质量责任落实情况、形成部门合力处置质量问题隐患情况等内容，围绕重点领域、重点产品、重点行为开展抽查核查，推动解决一批社会关切和群众反映强烈的突出质量问题。（央视新闻）
text_en: The Office of the Coordinating Group for Building a Quality Power jointly with relevant member units recently formed four quality inspection teams and launched the second batch of quality inspections for 2026. Starting November 5, the four teams successively stationed in Anhui, Jiangxi, Henan, Sichuan and other provinces, and will continue to focus on the implementation of the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on quality work, the fulfillment of quality responsibilities, and the formation of departmental synergy in addressing quality problems and hidden dangers, conducting spot checks and verifications in key areas, key products and key behaviors, and pushing to resolve a number of prominent quality issues of social concern and strong public complaint. (CCTV News)
